card.name: Inside the word exacerbation in warnings
card.fires_on: The letter piece 'B' partway through the capitalized word EXACERBATION in hepatitis warning headings. It also fires on a few other mid-word pieces, such as 'i' in fasciitis.

modes.label: Exacerbation in boxed warnings
modes.description: The 'B' piece inside capitalized EXACERBATION(S) in a hepatitis B post-treatment warning heading.
modes.example: WARNING: POST TREATMENT ACUTE EXACER<<B>>ATIONS OF HEPATITIS B

modes.label: Other mid-word pieces
modes.description: Scattered pieces inside rarer long words, such as fasciitis or syndicate.

card.plain: It marks the middle of the word exacerbation in hepatitis warning headings, where the rest of the word is easy to predict.
